_doc: One Codex image per piece, never a sheet. `refs` are extra style anchors (paths relative to the project root) after art_source/sprites_tiles_d.png. `bg` is 'opaque' (fills the frame) or 'key' (flat magenta background, keyed to alpha by terrain_build.py).
style: Modern pixel art with a dynamic-lighting look for a 2D side-scrolling metroidvania: chunky visible pixels, rich shading with soft highlights, bright saturated lively colours, hand-made feel like the attached reference sheet but lighter and more colourful. Crisp pixel edges, no anti-aliased blur, no text, no watermark, no border or frame.
rules: There are no torches, fire, tools or human-made objects anywhere. Light comes only from glowing prismatic crystals, bioluminescent fungus, flowers and lichen. The mood is wonder and life, warm and welcoming, never gloomy, grey or near-black: even the darkest areas keep visible colour.
key: The background is flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) with no gradient, no shadow and no magenta anywhere on the subject.
opaque: The image fills the whole frame edge to edge.

cave.palette: Palette: warm lavender-grey and cream stone with rose, amber and cyan mineral flecks; lush emerald and lime moss with tiny pink, yellow and white flowers; large prismatic crystals whose facets shift through rose, gold, mint, cyan and violet like opal or a rainbow; soft warm-white and rainbow glow.

fill_a.prompt: A seamless, tileable texture of cave stone wall made of irregular fitted stones in warm lavender-grey and cream, with small rose, amber and cyan mineral flecks and a few tiny glinting crystal facets. Flat straight-on view, no perspective, no moss on top, brighter and friendlier than a dungeon wall. Left/right and top/bottom edges must continue seamlessly. Square 1024x1024.

backwall.prompt: A seamless tileable texture of a recessed far cave back wall: large soft slabs of lavender and teal stone with cracks and faint glints of coloured crystal, calmer and a little darker than the reference stone so a character in front stands out, but still colourful, not grey or black. Edges continue seamlessly. Square 1024x1024.

cap_top.prompt: A wide horizontal strip, 1536x384: the TOP EDGE of a cave floor block, side view. The lower 65% is the same stone as the reference stone texture. The top surface is a roughly flat walkable lip covered with vivid emerald and lime moss, tiny pink, yellow and white flowers, and short glowing mint lichen tufts. Above the surface is magenta. The far-left and far-right ends must continue seamlessly so the strip tiles horizontally.

cap_bottom.prompt: A wide horizontal strip, 1536x384: the UNDERSIDE EDGE of a cave ceiling block, side view. The upper 65% is the same stone as the reference stone texture. The lower surface is a jagged underside with small stalactite points, dripping glowing droplets, short hanging moss and tiny pastel crystal tips in rose and cyan. Below the surface is magenta. The far-left and far-right ends must continue seamlessly so the strip tiles horizontally.

edge_left.prompt: A tall vertical strip, 512x1536: the LEFT FACE of a solid cave rock wall, side view. The right 70% is the same fitted-stone texture as the reference. The left boundary is a ragged, slightly irregular rocky silhouette of rounded stones sticking out by different amounts, with a lighter rim and patches of green moss and a few tiny pebbles. Only stone and moss: no large crystals. To the left of the silhouette is magenta. The top and bottom ends must continue seamlessly so the strip tiles vertically.

The middle 60% must be a uniform repeatable stretch so it can be lengthened. Magenta everywhere else.
